turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I got two job offers and a maybe on a third, and I need help thinking it through.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first one pays the most, but it's an hour commute each way and the team seemed kind of tense.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's a smaller company, a bit less money, but fully remote with a really friendly manager.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is a big company with great benefits and training, but the role is pretty junior.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is the maybe, a startup doing something exciting, but they haven't made an offer yet.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: What matters most to you right now, money, growth, or quality of life? If it's quality of life, the remote job is the clear pick. I wouldn't wait too long on the startup, since they haven't even made an offer.
